jobs_results.description:
Description

The Enterprise Microsoft Copilot Studio, Copilot Cowork, and Claude Cowork Architect will help the organization safely enable Microsoft Copilot Studio, Copilot Cowork, Claude Cowork (Anthropic), Copilot agents, and related agentic AI capabilities.

This role will define the standards, design patterns, guardrails, and solution design practices needed to support secure, compliant, scalable, and policy-aligned adoption across the enterprise.

The architect will partner with enterprise architecture, security, risk, compliance, privacy, data governance, platform, engineering, workforce technology, and business teams to ensure Copilot-based and Claude-based solutions are designed responsibly and operated effectively.

This is a hands-on architecture leadership role focused on enabling business value while protecting enterprise data, enforcing governance expectations, and reducing delivery risk across a multi-vendor agentic AI landscape.

Key Deliverables

	Enterprise component standards for Microsoft Copilot Studio, Copilot Cowork, and Claude Cowork.

	Reference architecture for Copilot agents, Cowork-enabled workflows, Claude Cowork multi-step autonomous workflows, integrations, data access, and enterprise deployment.

	Reusable design pattern catalog for common agent, workflow, knowledge-grounding, approval, escalation, and integration scenarios.

	Solution design template and architecture review checklist for Copilot Studio, Copilot Cowork, and Claude Cowork implementations.

	Guardrails for security, privacy, data governance, responsible AI, connector usage, identity and access, auditability, monitoring, and operational readiness.

	Endpoint and desktop governance guidance for Claude Cowork, including device configuration, local file and application access boundaries, and managed deployment controls.

	Platform selection guidance that clarifies when to use Copilot Studio, Copilot Cowork, or Claude Cowork for a given business scenario.

	Environment, tenant, lifecycle management, deployment, and support model guidance for enterprise adoption.

	Decision records and exception-handling process for solution-specific architecture, security, or governance deviations.

	Executive-ready recommendations, roadmap input, and adoption guidance for scaling Copilot Studio, Copilot Cowork, and Claude Cowork across the enterprise.

Responsibilities

	Define the enterprise architecture approach for Microsoft Copilot Studio, Copilot Cowork, Claude Cowork, Copilot agents, and related agentic AI capabilities.

	Create and maintain standards, design patterns, reference architectures, and guardrails for secure and governed adoption.

	Lead solution design for Copilot Studio, Copilot Cowork, and Claude Cowork implementations, ensuring each solution has clear business purpose, approved data sources, defined ownership, security controls, and measurable outcomes.

	Partner with Security, Risk, Compliance, Privacy, Legal, Data Governance, Workforce Technology, and platform administration teams to align solutions with enterprise policies and standards.

	Define guidance for knowledge sources, connectors, actions, prompts, approvals, grounding, monitoring, and human oversight.

	Shape environment strategy, data policies, application lifecycle management, deployment controls, usage visibility, billing controls, and operational support practices.

	Define endpoint governance, access controls, and usage policies for Claude Cowork, and support proof-of-concept evaluation and transition to production where approved.

	Establish architecture review criteria and reusable checklists for Copilot Studio, Copilot Cowork, Claude Cowork, and Copilot agent solutions.

	Provide hands-on architecture guidance to delivery teams from concept through design, build, test, deployment, and production readiness.

	Define integration patterns across Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Dataverse, SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Microsoft Graph, Anthropic Claude, APIs, enterprise applications, workflow platforms, and knowledge repositories.

	Develop patterns for observability, audit trails, task execution visibility, quality evaluation, prompt testing, incident response, and continuous improvement.

	Evaluate emerging Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Copilot Cowork, Claude Cowork, Power Platform, Azure AI, Agent 365, and agentic AI capabilities for enterprise applicability.

	Facilitate architecture governance discussions and approvals, promoting reuse, consistency, policy alignment, and risk-based decision making.

	Communicate architecture decisions, risks, trade-offs, standards, and recommendations clearly to executive, business, architecture, engineering, and platform stakeholders.

	Mentor architects, makers, and engineering teams on enterprise-ready Copilot Studio, Copilot Cowork, and Claude Cowork design practices.

Qualifications

	Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

	Eight or more years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, platform architecture, software engineering, cloud engineering, or technology delivery.

	Experience designing and governing enterprise solutions across Microsoft 365, Power Platform, cloud, SaaS, data, integration, and enterprise application environments.

	Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Copilot Cowork, Claude Cowork, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Power Platform, Power Automate, Dataverse, Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Azure services, or comparable AI and automation platforms.

	Experience creating architecture standards, reference architectures, design patterns, solution guardrails, and architecture review criteria.

	Strong understanding of identity and access management, data loss prevention, connector governance, API security, endpoint security, logging, monitoring, billing controls, and operational readiness.

	Strong understanding of responsible AI, AI governance, human oversight, content grounding, privacy, sensitive data handling, auditability, and compliance expectations.

	Experience designing integrations across APIs, Microsoft 365 services, enterprise applications, workflow platforms, data platforms, and knowledge repositories.

	Experience working within Agile, DevOps, SDLC, architecture governance, technology risk management, and change management practices.

	Strong communication, facilitation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.

	Ability to explain complex architecture topics to both executive and technical audiences.

Job Type & Location

This is a Contract position based out of Cedar Rapids, IA.

Pay and BenefitsThe pay range for this position is $75.00 - $110.00/hr.

jobs_results.description:
Amentum is a global leader in advanced engineering and innovative technology solutions, trusted by the United States and its allies to address their most significant and complex challenges in science, security and sustainability. Our people apply undaunted curiosity, relentless ambition and boundless imagination to challenge convention and drive progress. Our commitments are underpinned by the belief that safety, collaboration and well-being are integral to success. Headquartered in Chantilly, Virginia, we have approximately 50,000 employees in more than 70 countries across all 7 continents.



The  AI Solutions Architect  — Programs & Delivery is the senior operational architect for Amentum's AI Center of Excellence. This role owns the technical execution backbone of the COE: JANUS (the COE's AI intake and portfolio system of record), pilot and lighthouse delivery pipeline, and the interface between the COE hub and Amentum's operating-group AI spokes.



The role bridges business demand, technical architecture, and governance to ensure AI initiatives are documented, planned, coordinated, and delivered against per-lighthouse execution criteria — not just inventoried.  This position Hybrid to our Reston, VA Office and US Citizenship is required.



Key Outcomes




Operate JANUS as the COE's portfolio system of record — drive waves of pilot and lighthouse records to completeness, coordinate gold-record certification, and prepare board-ready evidence for Amentum’s AI Advisory Council.


Drive technical delivery coordination across waves of lighthouse initiatives against signed charters and pilot execution criteria.


Interface the COE hub with operating-group spokes so reusable architecture patterns flow both directions enabling growth.


Coordinate with AI Governance, Cyber, CIO/EA, Legal, Export Control, Finance, and Procurement liaisons to keep boundary approvals on schedule for lighthouse production paths.


Track risks, dependencies, and decision-package status across the AI portfolio; support COE leadership and the AI Advisory Council with timely, evidence-backed status.




Core Responsibilities




Own day-to-day operation of JANUS for COE intake, triage, prioritization, and lifecycle tracking of AI use cases.


Translate business problems into technical AI solution architectures, identifying reusable patterns and platform components across AI Pilots.


Support the AI Solution Architect — Generative AI (peer role) on integration, deployment, and operational hand-off of GenAI capabilities into mission and enterprise workflows.


Coordinate with spoke leads on lighthouse charter execution, surfacing blockers to the Chief AI Architect and the AI Advisory Council.


Maintain the COE decision log and Council package readiness on a monthly cadence.


Partner with vendor Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) during platform buildout, ensuring reusable patterns are documented and transitioned to internal owners with FDE exit criteria met.


Maintain alignment between AI work and Amentum's two-cloud posture (Azure Commercial for COE, Azure Government for customer-mandated programs).




Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:




Strong program-architecture judgment — ability to sequence work, identify dependencies, and call risks early.


Ability to operate across executive (CTO, Council), technical (engineering, IT, data), and business-unit (spoke) stakeholders.


Excellent written and verbal communication; comfort preparing board-level decision packages.


Detail-oriented in a fast-moving environment; strong organizational and follow-through skills.




Minimum Requirements




Typically 5+ years of progressive experience in AI / data program architecture, AI portfolio management, or enterprise solution delivery with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or related field. Master's preferred.


Experience operating an enterprise intake / portfolio system for AI, data, or technology initiatives.


Working knowledge of AI/ML solution architecture, including data pipelines, model integration patterns, and platform components.


Hands-on familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure preferred; AWS or GCP also acceptable).


Experience working with structured and semi-structured data, databases, and integration patterns across enterprise systems.


US Citizenship is required.




Preferred Qualifications




Experience in a federal services, government, or mission-driven environment.


Exposure to AI governance frameworks (model risk, responsible AI, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act categorization).


Background coordinating multi-vendor AI engagements (RFI/RFP, Forward Deployed Engineering, hyperscaler partnerships).


Experience with Azure AI services, Microsoft Copilot ecosystem, and/or AWS Bedrock.




Work Environment:  Hybrid; collaborative technical/business environment spanning CTO Office and operating-group spokes.



Work Schedule:  Standard business hours with flexibility; occasional travel to spoke sites.



Compensation Details:



$160k - $180k

jobs_results.job_title: Senior Principal AI Security Solutions Architect
jobs_results.description:
The security of customers’ data and systems is of paramount importance to Dell Technologies. Our Product Security Engineering team designs and develops software and systems to minimize security risks within our products. As experts working at the cutting edge of security, we undertake vulnerability response handling, implement the security development lifecycle, coordinate security certifications and develop common software security components and toolkits. As well as ensuring the authenticity and integrity of the product code during product development, we mitigate risks of sourcing and delivery of counterfeit or maliciously tainted components in our products.  

 Dell Technologies Security and Resiliency organization manages security risk across all aspects of Dell's business. We are experiencing tremendous growth as we continue to meet the security needs of one of the world's largest technology companies. With team members located in more than 15 countries, you will have an exceptional opportunity to influence Dell's security culture while advancing your career. 

Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a Senior Principal AI Security Solutions Architect on our Security and Resiliency team in Round Rock, Texas. Relocation assistance is available.

jobs_results.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.

(remote US based)

Role Overview:

The Principal AI Solutions Architect helps strategic customers turn ambitious AI initiatives into production-ready solutions that improve customer experience, operational performance, and enterprise adoption. Supporting the newly launched Agentic AI Orchestration program, this role combines hands-on architecture and rapid prototyping with executive-level customer engagement, technical leadership, and ownership of measurable outcomes.

You will partner directly with customer business and technology leaders to identify high-value opportunities, shape AI strategy, and design scalable solutions across Genesys Cloud, agentic AI, conversational AI, automation, data, and enterprise integrations. The role owns the technical journey from discovery and architecture through proof of concept, production deployment, optimization, and expansion.

At Genesys, collaboration, empathy, and innovation shape how we help organizations orchestrate personalized experiences at scale. You will gain strategic enterprise AI exposure and senior leadership visibility, while influencing initiatives across Customer Success, Product, Innovation, Solution Consulting, Professional Services, and Support.

Own end-to-end technical engagement with strategic customers, translating complex business challenges and customer experience KPIs into scalable AI solutions that deliver measurable valueLead discovery, requirements analysis, solution architecture, integration, deployment, and optimization across Genesys Cloud, AI, data, automation, and omnichannel CXPrioritize AI initiatives based on patterns, data flows, and governance approaches for AI-powered experience orchestration across enterprise platformsLead process redesign and architecture workshops that improve customer journeys, Agents, Copilots, and related AI capabilities, with clear paths to production scalability and enterprise adoptionGuide integration of Genesys AI capabilities with CRM, ERP, cloud, data, API, and third-party ecosystems using REST APIs, event-driven architectures, JSON, and LLM servicesDrive continuous value engineering after launch by evaluating performance against customer KPIs, tuning AI solutions, identifying expansion opportunities, and developing roadmaps for sustained business impactInfluence technical direction across the broader delivery ecosystem by engaging specialists from items: Lead the design and delivery of artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled customer experiences across marketing, commerce, sales, and service

Solutions Architect - AI

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time, Direct Hire

Position Summary

Our client is seeking an experienced Solutions Architect - AI to lead the design and implementation of enterprise AI solutions across a complex, large-scale business environment.

This individual will serve as both a hands-on technical architect and strategic AI leader, helping identify high-value use cases, establish scalable architecture standards, evaluate emerging technologies, and move AI solutions from concept through production.

Responsibilities

- Define enterprise architecture, standards, and reusable patterns for AI, machine learning, and Generative AI solutions.
- Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready AI architectures.
- Partner with business, product, engineering, data, and technology teams to identify and prioritize AI opportunities.
- Architect end-to-end AI solutions covering data ingestion, model development, inference, integration, and production deployment.
- Design solutions utilizing Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, vector search, tool calling, and agentic workflows.
- Evaluate and implement open-source AI and machine learning technologies.
- Provide hands-on technical guidance, including reference architectures, pipelines, schemas, and development patterns.
- Establish MLOps practices including CI/CD, model monitoring, automated retraining, drift detection, and cost management.
- Develop AI observability standards covering model performance, data quality, system health, latency, and production feedback loops.
- Establish security and governance standards for enterprise AI solutions.
- Address AI-specific risks including prompt injection, adversarial attacks, data poisoning, model security, and privacy concerns.
- Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine how they can be integrated into existing enterprise applications and platforms.
- Lead build vs. buy vs. open-source evaluations for AI capabilities.
- Help establish and mature enterprise AI governance and Center of Excellence capabilities.
- Partner with technical teams to ensure AI architectures are practical, scalable, secure, and executable.
- Help teams adopt AI technologies and productivity tools safely and effectively.

Required Qualifications

- 9+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, AI, machine learning, or related technology disciplines.
- 5+ years of experience in AI/ML architecture or a comparable technical leadership role.
- Proven experience designing and delivering production AI solutions within retail, e-commerce, supply chain, or a large consumer-facing environment.
- Strong hands-on experience with open-source AI and machine learning frameworks.
- Strong proficiency with Python and modern machine learning frameworks.
- Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, RAG architectures, vector search, and agentic AI technologies.
- Experience with modern enterprise data architectures including lakehouse, streaming, and batch-processing environments.
- Experience with enterprise cloud and data platforms.
- Demonstrated experience with MLOps, model monitoring, drift detection, and production AI observability.
- Understanding of AI security, governance, privacy, and responsible AI practices.
- Experience evaluating and integrating emerging AI technologies into existing enterprise environments.
- Ability to operate as both a hands-on technical builder and enterprise-level architect.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience helping establish or scale an enterprise AI Center of Excellence.
- Direct experience within a retail or large consumer-facing organization.
- Experience with AI red-teaming, adversarial testing, or AI risk assessment.
- Experience contributing to or implementing open-source AI technologies.
- Relevant cloud, AI, or machine learning certifications.
